about: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description; where a method is inferred rather than stated by the description, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, and there is no separate task behind it. Treat it as a progress meter rather than a goal of its own. Work through the roadmap in this guide and this one takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of the story. It is the game's introduction, so it cannot be missed and needs no preparation. As the description states, finishing the mission is all it takes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its missions in story order. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends, so there is nothing to hunt for separately. Just follow the story and it comes to you.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its missions in story order. Like the other chapter trophies, this one pops when the chapter closes and cannot be missed. Keep pushing the story forward and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its missions in story order. The trophy pops at the chapter's end, so no side task is needed. If you are tracking the platinum, this is a milestone, not a grind.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its missions in story order. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it pops when the chapter ends. Nothing here can be missed, so just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It unlocks after the earlier chapters are done, so you reach it simply by completing the story. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it marks the end of the main plot rather than a side grind.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission flow. The name is the mission's own title, so watch for it in the story rather than hunting around the map. Finishing the mission pops the trophy at once.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears. Heist missions in this series usually ask for some preparation first, so arrive with supplies and a plan, but the trophy itself only asks that you finish the mission. It pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in your mission flow. The trophy is tied to that one mission only, so there is no extra objective to chase. Finish it and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears. As the description states, the mission itself is the whole requirement. Play it through to its ending and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, which takes place around the airport, as the name suggests. The trophy only asks that you finish the mission. Expect a fight on the way in and a getaway on the way out, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears. The mission's title is the only detail the description gives, so treat it as a story beat to play through rather than a task to prepare for. Finish it and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which the game tracks across story, stranger missions, collectibles and activities. This is the long grind of the platinum: nearly every other trophy feeds into it, so it usually pops near the very end. Check your in-game stats regularly to see which category is still short, and finish that category rather than wandering.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, flights under bridges and similar feats the game counts as you land them. Player guides report there are well over 250 stunts in the world, so you do not need every one of them. Work through them steadily with fast vehicles and aircraft, and use the in-game stunt counter to track your progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity once: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges and whatever else the game offers. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so this is a sampler, not a grind. Player guides report nine activity types in total, so if one type is still missing, look for an activity icon you have never visited.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge; PlayStation tracks 42 of them. This is a skill trophy, so practise one challenge at a time and learn its target pattern before chasing gold. Use the weapon the challenge gives you, aim for headshots where they pay, and replay a challenge as many times as you need, since nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that offers one. Drone races are about clean lines through the gates, so learn each course's turns before pushing for speed. Player guides report 14 race locations, so expect a full tour of the map, and replay any location you lose until you win it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, so variety matters more than repeating one easy race. Try street races, off-road races and any other race type the map offers, and upgrade your vehicles as you go. Each first win on a new race counts, and the trophy pops on the twentieth.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests, so the aim is to out-fish your rival rather than just catch something. Take the challenge when it is offered, keep your line steady, and the trophy pops when you win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade. You only need to finish a game, not beat a high score, so pick the simplest machine you find. It is a quick trophy to grab whenever you pass an arcade.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands unlock as you meet their characters around Leonida, so keep answering Andy's calls and playing each mission he offers. Player guides report that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave Andy's missions sitting unfinished while you push the story far ahead.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger mission strand. Play each of Kenton's missions as they appear, and finish the strand before moving deep into the later story. Player guides report that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so this is one to clear promptly rather than save for after the finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger mission strand. Follow Billy's missions as they come up around Leonida and finish the strand when its final mission appears. Player guides report that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so do not let this one drift while the story advances.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as characters with their own mission chains, so explore the map, answer their calls and finish each chain you start. The five named stranger finals in this list count toward the eight, so this trophy usually pops once you have worked through most of the strangers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger mission strand. Play Randy's missions as they appear and finish the strand when its final mission unlocks. Player guides report that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so clear Randy's chain before pushing far into the later chapters.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Follow Tyrone's missions as they appear around Leonida and finish the strand when its final mission is offered. Player guides report that stranger strands have windows tied to story progress, so treat this one as time-sensitive within the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the one trophy player guides flag as possibly missable, so start meditating early and visit each spot as you discover it rather than saving them all for the end. Player guides report 18 spots in total; meditate at each one and the trophy pops on the last.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, a stranger who asks you to track a specific creature. Unique hunts are about patience: follow the trail, watch the animal's habits and take the shot only when it is clean. The description names one animal, so this is a single hunt, not a set of them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets by finding cards scattered around Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt, so check shops, hideouts and out-of-the-way spots as you travel. Player guides report 18 sets in the game, so you only need three of them; finish any three sets and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations across Leonida: landmarks, curiosities and odd sights the app recognises. This is a sightseeing grind, so scan everything you pass instead of making special trips at the end. The counter climbs as you explore, and the trophy pops at the hundredth scan.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small side goals, so they pile up naturally as you race, stunt, shoot and explore. If you are short near the end, look for the easiest unfinished challenges in your checklist rather than starting hard ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops and escape. The partner requirement is the tricky part: start the heat during a mission or activity where your partner is with you. Once the stars are up, break line of sight, use tunnels and back roads, and stay out of the search area until the heat fades.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three close-together shops first, and keep moving: the trick is to stay wanted the whole time, not to escape. If the heat drops to zero between shops, the chain breaks and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by driving, riding or simply getting into new ones. Every new model you sit in counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar instead of sticking to one favourite car. Rare and unusual vehicles count the same as common ones, so variety is the whole strategy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming mode. Set it up where enemies cluster: start a fight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them quickly before it runs out. An automatic weapon helps, and you can retry the fight as often as you like.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport: in plain terms, take a plane out without going through the normal channels. The description is deliberately vague, so treat it as a stunt at the airport rather than a scheduled flight. Grab a plane on the tarmac and get it into the air, and the trophy should pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description only jokes that it is hot in these Rhinos, so the method is inferred from the name and the wording: get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem with it. Tanks are military vehicles, so expect to find one at a base or during a mission that provides one. Drive it, fire it, survive the response, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole point: go in quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again, since a clean run is what counts.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank robberies bring heavy police attention, so plan your getaway before you go in: a fast car parked close by and a route away from the main roads. Each successful escape counts, and the trophy pops on the fifth.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so watch for one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash. The escape matters as much as the robbery, so have a getaway vehicle ready and lose the cops before you relax.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida, from Vice City to the swamps and small towns. The game tracks which areas you have visited, so drive the highways, take the back roads and visit each named region. This pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies, so finish it while you hunt cards, WAiNK spots and meditation spots.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own rackets, so you need one hit per gang, not several hits on the same one. Scout each gang's territory, hit their operation, and get out clean; the trophy pops once every gang has been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description gives the place and the act, so head to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water and order a drink. It is a quiet moment trophy: no combat, no chase, just the right place and the right drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. The description is a nod to the series' classic opening chaos, so pick a showroom, build speed inside, and go through the window. One clean smash is all it takes.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: go bowling there and finish a game. The description names the alley, so this is a visit trophy, not a score trophy. Bowl a full game and the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague, speaking only of a partnership with mass appeal, so the exact trigger is not stated by the official list. Player guides have not confirmed a method for this one yet, so treat it as a story or activity trophy that pops as you play rather than one to chase directly. Keep playing through the story and side content and watch for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description speaks only of choices made, for better or worse, so this trophy is tied to a decision in the story rather than a task you can repeat. The wording itself is the warning: a choice, once made, may not be undoable. Keep a separate save before big story decisions so you can return to them if a choice locks you out.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description only says second time's the charm, so the method is inferred from the wording: something in the game that fails the first time and works on the second attempt. Player guides have not confirmed a method for this one yet, so do not force it. Play naturally, retry anything that fails, and this one should pop on a second attempt somewhere in the story.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description only asks what the hell just happened, so this trophy is tied to a strange or surprising story moment rather than a task you can plan for. Player guides have not confirmed a method for this one yet. Play through the story and the odd moment behind it will find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: strike people with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, knocking them down like pins. The description gives the method plainly, so find a vehicle, pick up a melee weapon, and drive through a group of enemies swinging. It is a stunt more than a fight, so a slow vehicle and a crowded street help.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts clean them for a cut, so keep robbing and keep laundering. The total is cumulative, so it builds up over the whole playthrough without any single big score.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. The total is cumulative and covers everything you buy: clothes, weapons, food, car upgrades and more. You will get much of the way there just by gearing up for missions, so save the big purchases for late in the game and the trophy pops on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this one is about saving up and visiting each property for sale. Buy them as you can afford them, and the trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the app and register each one you want to keep. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and the trophy pops on the tenth.
